name: wordle
title: Wordle
description: The five-letter word game in the panel, keyboard only: a daily puzzle, the same everywhere, and practice words once it is done. Your streak and stats are kept, and follow you to every machine you sign in on.
author: pal

settings.label: Daily puzzle
settings.text: One puzzle a day from the date
settings.description: Opening the palette on a new day starts that day's word, the same on every machine. Off, every game is a random word.

settings.label: Hard mode
settings.description: A guess must keep every green letter in place and use every amber one. Applies from the next game.

store.tagline: Wordle in the panel: a daily puzzle, practice words, stats
features: Type a guess and press `enter`; the tiles flip green, amber or grey and the keyboard colours as you go
A daily puzzle from the date, the same on every machine; `n` for practice words once it is done
Hard mode keeps greens in place and makes ambers count; an unknown word is flagged over the board
Stats: played, win %, streak and the guess distribution; `c` copies the emoji grid to share
Leave any time and come back to the same game, even after a restart
The word lists ship with it; nothing is fetched
Each daily's guesses go on that puzzle's leaderboard, your longest streak on another; signed in to a pal account, the game, the stats and the streak follow you to every machine

screenshots.caption: The daily, three guesses in and two letters typed: the keyboard shows what the guesses found
A word that is not in the list: a notice under the title, and the row stays for editing
Solved in four: the praise, the stats and the guess distribution, C copies the grid

actions.title: Type a letter
actions.description: Any letter key fills the current row.

actions.title: Submit the guess
actions.description: Five letters that make a word in the list.

actions.title: Delete a letter
actions.description: Backspace takes the last letter back.

actions.title: Copy the result
actions.description: The emoji grid with the puzzle number and the score, once the game is over.

actions.title: Today's puzzle / Practice game
actions.description: New game: today's puzzle if it is unplayed, else a practice word. `n` once the game is over, `cmd+n` while a practice game is on.

actions.title: Sign in
actions.description: After a daily while signed out: opens Settings › Account, so your scores are kept with your account.

wordle.title: Wordle
wordle.description: The board. Escape leaves mid-game; the game is there when you come back.
